python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'dvc/stage/cache.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('dvc.stage.cache')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)

from types import SimpleNamespace
from dvc.stage.cache import _can_hash
def dep(protocol='local', def_path='data', h='abc'):
    d = SimpleNamespace()
    d.protocol = protocol
    d.def_path = def_path
    d.get_hash = lambda: h
    return d
def out(out_hash='def'):
    o = SimpleNamespace()
    o.protocol = 'local'
    o.def_path = 'out'
    o.get_hash = lambda: out_hash
    o.use_cache = True
    o.persist = False
    o.is_in_repo = True
    return o
def stage(cmd='echo', deps=None, outs=None):
    s = SimpleNamespace()
    s.is_callback = False
    s.always_changed = False
    s.cmd = cmd
    s.deps = deps if deps is not None else [dep()]
    s.outs = outs if outs is not None else [out()]
    return s
good = stage()
assert _can_hash(good) is True
print("get_hit", True)
assert _can_hash(stage()) is True
print("equivalence", True)
remote = stage(deps=[dep(protocol='s3')])
assert _can_hash(remote) is False, "non-local dep must invalidate cacheability"
print("invalidate", True)
hashless = stage(deps=[dep(h=None)])
assert _can_hash(hashless) is False
print("isolation", True)
fixed = stage(deps=[dep()])
assert _can_hash(fixed) is True
print("recompute", True)

PYREPLAY
